about_short_description.short_description: Bottomless is a coffee service that uses a smart scale to deliver roasted coffee based on users' consumption.

product.name: Coffee Subscription Service
product.description: A service that delivers freshly roasted coffee based on user consumption, using a smart scale to track usage and automatically reorder at the optimal time.

product.name: Powered by Bottomless
product.description: A service that enables roasters and brands to offer automatic re-stocking of their products based on customer usage, integrated with their e-commerce platforms.

product.name: Pet Food Beta
product.description: A beta service that delivers pet food based on consumption, using a smart scale to track usage and automatically reorder when needed.

product.name: BYO Products
product.description: A closed beta program that allows customers to ship any product from any e-commerce site using Bottomless's existing hardware or custom prototypes.
